newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel says users believe tunnel is safe.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says users believe tunnel is safe.

text.p: Eurotunnel Plc, the debt-laden Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator still smarting after being hit by a major fire last November, said on Monday its commissioned customer poll showed most of the British and French customers still believed the tunnel was safe.

The group asked pollsters Gallup to carry out a series of surveys in the UK and France between November 21 and January 10. The results showed that 77 percent of the French believed the tunnel was safe, with 68 percent of the British confident of its safety.
Those results were taken from the poll carried out on 12/13 December.
The survey also claimed that a high percentage of those surveyed in France and the UK saw the tunnel as "a great Franco/British achievement."
Eurotunnel said the Gallup responses showed the public had a positive impression of the way the company's staff handled the crisis.
